name: A. M. Sinnott
bio: A. M. Sinnott was a Medora resident who was ill with rheumatism in early 1884 and passed through in July 1884 on his way to Butte City, where a letter in April 1885 showed him doing well. By December 1886 the paper listed him among the old-timers who had moved away, living in Marshfield, Massachusetts.

mentions: Mr. A. M. Sinnot has been sick for some time with inflammatory rheumatism, but has now nearly recovered.
Father Cassidy, of Mandan, is visiting Geo. Fitzgerald.
Mr. Avery, who has been visiting A. M. Sinnott for some time, has returned east.
A. M. Sinnott is in town on his way to Butte City.
A letter from A. M. Sinnott, dated at Butte City seems to indicate that he is doing well in his new home.
A. M. Sinnott went east on No. 2, yesterday on his pay to Bismarck. Thence he will go to Marshfield, Mass.
